digest.component_or_area: binding-state repository persistence and selective publication
propositions: Repository delegation must enforce ownership boundaries between local multi-file persistence and selective tickets-branch publication without publishing repository checkpoints independently.
Publication must stage only the existing five allowlisted bridge-state files and must not broaden staging or publish unrelated changes.
Unchanged passes must create no commit, and GET rotation and retired-first publication semantics must preserve pre-extraction recovery floors.
ADR 0099 must document repository versus publication ownership, ordered partial-state behavior, rollback semantics, and explicit decisions against journal/format-migration.
Regression tests must prove five-file allowlist enforcement, unchanged-pass behavior, rotation floor preservation, and repository checkpoint isolation remain intact across the S1 cutover.
